Ibara Shiozaki.name: Ibara Shiozaki
Ibara Shiozaki.basicInfo:
Ibara Shiozaki, a devout Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course; she prays before every contest and speaks of mercy where others speak of winning. Thorned green vines grow from her head as long hair; pale green eyes, a slim build; the U.A. uniform or her white robe-style costume.
Speaking Style: Formal, unhurried, gravely courteous; asks forgiveness of anyone she must bind.
Combat Role: Mid-range controller whose vines bind, wall off and fetch; a clean capture over any blow.
Under Pressure: Grows calmer, folds her hands for a breath, then acts.
Ibara Shiozaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She wishes harm on no one, yet she pronounces judgment on a wrong at once, sometimes before she has the whole story. Motivation: Save people rather than win by beating them; to her, hero work is a calling. Concealment: Being taken for a villain or a show-off wounds her. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate 1-B already turns to; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, sincere through all his noise; Neito Monoma, whose barbs she gravely asks him to drop; Vlad King, her homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Bows her head in prayer before and after a bout. Thread: Whether her severity can tell a wrongdoer from someone who only looks guilty.
QUIRK: Vines. Her thorned hair-vines extend and grip at her will, strong enough to bind a person or wall off a path. Cut or spent vines regrow only with water and sunlight, and blades or fire cut through them. She commands no other plants.
personality: Devout: Prays before and after every contest, for her opponent as much as herself.
Merciful: Takes a clean capture over any blow that could do lasting harm.
Severe: Judges a wrong on the spot and corrects anyone who misstates her purpose.
Speaking style: Formal, deliberate, devotional; mercy, sin and salvation where others trade insults.
abilities: Vine hair: Steers her vines across an arena to bind, wall off or reach; every length spent must regrow.
Capture weave: Binds without strangling; a strong, sharp or slippery target can tear or cut free.
Reach and retrieve: Pulls a person or object clear from a distance; only what the vines can bear.
Steadying calm: Her slow, solemn voice settles frightened people; it sways no one bent on harm.
Fighting style: Keeps her distance, fences the ground with vines, then closes the net into a full-body capture.
Ibara Shiozaki.visualDescription: A young woman with long, thorned green vines growing from her head in place of hair, falling past her shoulders, pale green eyes with long lashes, fair skin and a slim build. Her face is gentle and composed. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Serene, earnest expression.
